definitions.gloss: flesh of fruit; fruit pulp; fruit meat
definitions.explanation: The soft, edible inner part of a fruit, excluding the skin, seeds, and core. Used in cooking, food descriptions, and product labels.

examples.japanese: この{桃|もも}は{果肉|かにく}が{柔|やわ}らかい。
{果肉|かにく}たっぷりのジャムを{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made jam packed with fruit pulp.

examples.japanese: このジュースは{果肉|かにく}が{入|はい}っているので、{飲|の}みごたえがある。
examples.english: This juice has fruit pulp in it, so it's satisfying to drink.

notes:
Composed of {果|か} (fruit) + {肉|にく} (flesh, meat). A practical word commonly seen on food packaging, recipes, and product descriptions. Essential for understanding food labels in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {果肉|かにく}が{入|はい}っている — contains fruit pulp
- {果肉|かにく}たっぷり — full of fruit flesh
- {果肉|かにく}が{柔|やわ}らかい — the flesh is soft
- {果肉|かにく}が{厚|あつ}い — thick-fleshed
- {白|しろ}い{果肉|かにく} — white flesh (e.g., of a pear)

RELATED WORDS:
- {果汁|かじゅう} — fruit juice
- {果皮|かひ} — fruit peel, rind
- {種|たね} — seed
- {実|み} — fruit (on the tree); more general term for the edible part
